surveys.title: Microsoft 365 Copilot evaluation (Department for Business and Trade)
surveys.audience: DBT staff with Copilot licences (~70% volunteers, ~30% randomly selected)
surveys.notes: 1,000 licences; 1.14 Copilot actions per user per day; NPS 31 (49% promoters, 18% detractors). Time saved per task: drafting 1.3h, summarising research 0.8h; scheduling -0.6h and image generation -0.5h (took longer). Evaluation found no clear organisation-level productivity gain (widely reported).

surveys.title: M365 Copilot Experiment Findings Report (cross-government)
surveys.audience: ~20,000 civil servants across 12 organisations incl. DWP, HMRC, Home Office, MoJ, DESNZ, DSIT, FCDO, DEFRA, DBT, Welsh Government, ONS, Companies House

items.label: Would not want to return to pre-Copilot working
Agree tool provides good value to the organisation

surveys.notes: n = 7,115 survey responses; usage telemetry from 14,500 users. Self-reported average 26 minutes saved per person per day (~13 working days/year); drafting 24 min, presentations 19 min, comms 9 min. Satisfaction 7.7/10, recommendation 8.2/10. No hallucination % in this report; no per-department breakdown on the page.
